title: Databases: Cloud SQL, Spanner, Firestore, and Bigtable — D4
purpose: Shows identities, trust boundaries, policy checks, and audit evidence.
routing_rationale: Relational workloads requiring strict global consistency use Cloud Spanner. Regional enterprise applications use Cloud SQL with synchronous replication.

nodes.label: Application Workload
nodes.detail: Handles customer checkout, inventory updates, and analytical telemetry.

nodes.label: Cloud SQL (Regional HA)
nodes.detail: Primary instance with synchronous persistent disk replication to standby zone.

nodes.label: Cloud Spanner (Global)
nodes.detail: Horizontally scalable relational database with external consistency worldwide.

nodes.label: Cloud Bigtable
nodes.detail: Sub-10ms write throughput for millions of IoT sensor events per second.

nodes.label: Cloud Firestore
nodes.detail: Real-time client synchronization and mobile offline data caching.

steps.title: Regional ACID Ingestion
steps.action: Orders service executes SQL transaction on Cloud SQL with automatic failover.
steps.why_traversal: Cloud SQL delivers standard relational compatibility with minimal operational toil.

steps.title: Global Consistency Commit
steps.action: Global inventory reservation commits across continents via Spanner Paxos quorum.
steps.why_traversal: TrueTime atomic clocks guarantee external consistency without distributed locking bottlenecks.

steps.title: Massive NoSQL Writes
steps.action: Real-time sensor logs stream into Bigtable tablets on Colossus shared storage.
steps.why_traversal: Bigtable handles millions of writes per second with sub-10ms response times.

scenarios.label: Monotonically Increasing Key Hotspotting
scenarios.root_cause: Application used sequential timestamp primary key (2026-09-24-001) causing write hotspot.
scenarios.diverted_path: Single Spanner split node saturates to 100% CPU; write latency spikes.
scenarios.blast_radius: All insert operations on that table delayed.
scenarios.recovery: Prepend hash prefix or use UUIDv4 to distribute writes across all cluster nodes.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Shows identities, trust boundaries, policy checks, and audit evidence.
